preconditions.description: Input S must be a string.
The length of S must be between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a substring of S.
The return value must be a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: all(len(sub) <= len(return_value) for sub in (S[i:j+1] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1]))
postconditions.description: The return value must have the maximum length among all palindromic substrings of S.

postconditions.expression: all(S[i:i+len(return_value)] != return_value or i >= return_start for i in range(len(S) - len(return_value) + 1))
postconditions.description: If there are multiple palindromic substrings with the maximum length, the one with the smallest starting index is returned.
